name: Hive 1.8.0
notes: Seamless remote agents. Standing up a headless agent on another machine is now one copy-paste line: an admin generates it from the People pane (Remote agents — enter a GitHub handle + role) or via hive-relay bootstrap-agent, and the developer runs 'brew install honeyhive-ai/hive/hive-cli && hive enroll … --token … && hive worker'. New CLI commands: hive enroll (decode a workspace invite → save config) and hive join (redeem an invite code). The issuer key that mints agent tokens stays local (Settings → Team sync); only the minted token travels. Builds on 1.7.0's automated setup + relay-managed teams.
